description: This file defines a CMake function 'dfs_callback' that performs a depth-first traversal of a data structure, emitting events for different node types such as lists and maps, and handling references to visited nodes. It is used for parsing complex nested data structures with callback mechanisms.

methods.name: dfs_callback
methods.description: Main function that initiates the depth-first traversal with a user-provided callback.

methods.name: dfs_callback_inner
methods.description: Inner recursive function that processes each node, emitting events based on node type.
